objective: Expand editorial reach and engagement by distributing story-format derivatives of daily editorial topics wherever a native Story route is actually supported and live-proven.

tiktok.temporary_rule: Use a vertical editorial adaptation as a normal TikTok photo/video post when useful, but NEVER label or count it as a TikTok Story.
tiktok.activation_gate: A TikTok Story can only be declared scheduled/published after a publisher or native route explicitly supporting TikTok Stories is verified live.

asset_rules: Story visual must be directly related to the film, series, character, release or discussion topic.
Allowed assets include rights-cleared official poster, key art, still, scene photo, frame, clip, EPK or other studio/producer press/editorial media.
No monochrome fallback, blank page, text-only card, generic stock, decorative unrelated visual or unrelated background.
If the editorial topic lacks a legal and directly relevant visual asset, replace the topic rather than publish a generic fallback.
The same rights and provenance gates used by feed editorials apply to Story assets.

editorial_logic.relationship_to_feed: Stories should derive from or amplify the same daily editorial agenda, but may use a different hook, poll, question or choice format.
editorial_logic.rule: Do not visually simulate a native poll/question sticker unless the publishing route actually supports that interactive element; otherwise use a clear visual CTA/question.
